caption: Wind gusts across a campfire, and the flames lean over and stretch out sideways before standing up again.

sa.check: The flames lean over to one side.
The flames stand up again afterwards.
Other signs of wind show: smoke, grass or clothing move the same way.
The order is upright, leaning, upright again.

pc.expect: The flames lean the way the wind blows, as the smoke and anything loose in the scene show, and stand up again when the gust passes.
pc.fail: The flames lean against the way the smoke and grass are blown; or the flames lean while the smoke rises straight up and nothing else moves; or the flames stay leaning after everything else has settled; or each flame leans a different way at the same moment.

pc.expect: Between gusts the flames point upward from the wood.
pc.fail: The flames point downward between gusts; or hang below the logs; or lie flat along the ground with no sign of wind; or point upward while the smoke above them sinks.

pc.expect: The leaning follows the gust and eases as it passes; the flames do not go out and relight on their own.
pc.fail: A flame goes out and relights with nothing touching it; or the lean grows steadily with no gust; or the flames flatten and stand in a rhythm unrelated to any visible sign of wind; or the flames stay flat while the smoke rises straight.

pc.expect: The smoke leans with the flames and streams downwind.
pc.fail: The smoke rises straight while the flames are flattened; or the smoke leans one way and the flames the other; or the smoke stops while the flames lean hard.

pc.expect: One fire with its logs; the flames stay on the wood and the logs keep their number.
pc.fail: A flame detaches from the wood and floats; or a second fire appears beside the first; or a log vanishes; or the flames pass through a log and out below it.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The logs, the stones and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The logs rearrange; or the stones change shape; or the background changes between frames.
